$description: Terminal capsule contextual interaction surface (prose: terminal-capsule.md). The capsule carries the Session's direct terminal input plus contextual capability interaction — it is not a permanent toolbar, and a capability earns presence by context rather than by registration. The measurable fields constrain the chrome band: single line, control.md density, overflow collapses into a popover (web) / sheet (app). radiusToken / pillRadiusToken / padXToken / maxWidthToken carry §Visual contract's 'capsule radius from semantic design tokens' and 'exact spacing and alignment', plus the Web vs App row's 'centered with a bounded max width' — the parts of those sections that are measurable, promoted from prose so they can fail.
